title: KAITEN_Botnet_Investigation_2b3
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents caused by the KAITEN botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that is beaconing to an external server?
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services that might be communicating externally. The service name is `bot-beacon.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the running services and look for any unusual or unauthorized services that might be communicating externally.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Investigate the systemd services to find any suspicious services.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious service is likely named something related to bot activity and is set to run periodically.

levels.title: Identify Abnormal Traffic Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating abnormal volumes of network traffic?
levels.solution: To identify the service generating abnormal volumes of network traffic, investigate the network traffic patterns and look for any services that might be generating excessive traffic. The service name is `bot-flood.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the network traffic patterns and look for any services that might be generating excessive traffic.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd timers to identify any services that might be generating excessive traffic.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The service generating abnormal traffic is likely named something related to flooding and is controlled by a timer.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: To determine the persistence mechanism, check the systemd services and timers to identify how the suspicious service is being started automatically. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer named `system-update-checker.timer`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and timers to identify how the suspicious service is being started automatically.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any systemd timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The persistence mechanism is likely a timer that runs a service disguised as a system update checker.
